items.title: Is the Illiquidity Premium Really Gone?
items.summary: He studies U.S. common stocks listed on the NYSE, Amex, and Nasdaq, using: Amihud’s illiquidity measure , which approximates price impact by dividing absolute daily returns by dollar trading volume.
items.finding: High-loan-fee stocks are disproportionately found among illiquid stocks.

items.title: Global Seasonality Factor Investing
items.summary: We study seasonality as a factor for predicting risk-adjusted returns across global futures markets.
items.finding: Empirical results demonstrate that adding seasonality to a global factor portfolio increases the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio by approximately $30\%$ over the full evaluation period.

items.title: ROIC vs WACC: The Spread That Separates Compounders From Value Traps
items.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary: A methodology note from the QuantaVal Research and Study series on return on invested capital versus the weighted average cost of capital: the formulas, a fully worked hypothetical example (ROIC 15.0% vs WACC 7.6%, spread +7.4 points), failure modes, and practical use.
items.finding: QuantaVal is a quantitative valuation engine — 88 models in the Hyper Engine, 62 in the free calculator — and every model publishes its full methodology free to read at quantaval.com.

items.title: UK Equity Exceptionalism
items.summary: Over the past 5 years, the exceptional US equity market generated a very healthy total return of 68%.

items.title: An integrated financial statement analysis and valuation method for stock investment decisions: Evidence from PT Bank Syariah Indonesia
items.venue: MUQTASID Jurnal Ekonomi dan Perbankan Syariah
items.summary: This study aimed to examine the role of financial statements in supporting stock investment decisions by integrating financial performance analysis with Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation
items.finding: The results showed consistent growth in assets, revenue, and net profit, as well as improvements in profitability ratios such as Return on Assets (ROA) and Return on Equity (ROE), reflecting enhanced operational efficiency.

items.title: Credit Rating Changes and Stock Market Reaction:The Impact of Investor Sentiment

items.title: Dangerous Liaisons? Debt Supply and Convenience Yield Spillovers in the Euro Area*
items.summary: The literature established that a sovereign bond’s “convenience yield” premium diminishes when that country issues more debt.
items.finding: Using high-frequency identification and debt management offices’ communication, we find that an increase in German or French debt reduces convenience yields across the eurozone.

items.title: The Sky’s the Limit: Asset Price Spirals When Margin Traders Are All In
items.summary: We analyze a setting in which some investors are all in and buy as much of a risky asset as their margins allow.

items.title: U.S. Employment Trends Index Edged Down in October, Conference Board Says

items.summary: When the market gets crazy, you’re itching to trade your portfolio, or just want to act on the latest breaking news, the decisions you weigh matter in the long run.
items.finding: Choosing active funds that underperform an index, chasing returns, trading your account, and other active decisions increase the chance of underperforming a simple portfolio with the appropriate asset mix to fit your goals, objectives, and risk tolerance.
